Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import json
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_receipt_data(image_path):
    """
    Extracts structured data from a receipt image using Google Cloud Document AI.
    Returns a dictionary with merchant, tax, total, and items.
    """
    # Provider-identifying setup: Google Cloud Document AI client and processor ID
    project_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    location = "us"  # Processor location
    processor_id = os.environ.get("DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID")  # Processor for invoices/receipts
    
    if not project_id or not processor_id:
        raise ValueError("Environment variables GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID must be set")
    
    # Initialize the Document AI client
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    processor_name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)
    
    # Read the image file
    with open(image_path, "rb") as image_file:
        image_content = image_file.read()
    
    # Create the raw document
    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=image_content, mime_type="image/jpeg")
    
    # Process the document
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=processor_name, raw_document=raw_document)
    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document
    
    # Extract structured data
    extracted_data = {
        "merchant": None,
        "tax": None,
        "total": None,
        "items": []
    }
    
    # Parse document entities
    for entity in document.entities:
        entity_type = entity.type_
        normalized_value = entity.normalized_value.text if entity.normalized_value else entity.mention_text
        
        if entity_type == "supplier_name":
            extracted_data["merchant"] = normalized_value
        elif entity_type == "total_tax_amount":
            extracted_data["tax"] = normalized_value
        elif entity_type == "total_amount":
            extracted_data["total"] = normalized_value
        elif entity_type == "line_item":
            # Parse line item details
            item = {}
            for prop in entity.properties:
                prop_type = prop.type_
                prop_value = prop.normalized_value.text if prop.normalized_value else prop.mention_text
                if prop_type == "line_item/description":
                    item["description"] = prop_value
                elif prop_type == "line_item/amount":
                    item["amount"] = prop_value
                elif prop_type == "line_item/quantity":
                    item["quantity"] = prop_value
            if item:
                extracted_data["items"].append(item)
    
    return extracted_data
